results.summary_before: Fir_Filter is an 11-coefficient fixed-point FIR filter that accepts an 8-bit digital audio signal on ui_in with a 4 kHz bandwidth and sends the filtered result out through a UART transmitter. Two select pins choose among four coefficient sets corresponding to high-pass, low-pass, band-pass, and all-pass responses. The documentation describes the filter types and selection pins but is thin on coefficient values, scaling, and the exact UART format. No external hardware is required, and the design is a straightforward DSP exercise on a 1x2 tile.
